Subject: PrimeWeek orientation: proposed kickoff windows & required attendees

Hi Alex and Priya —

Thanks for moving quickly here. We want to lock the customer kickoff for Integrata Health (PrimeWeek project) the week of Sep 21 so the implementation team can get access, environments, and prework done in week 1. Proposed windows (all ET):

- Tue 2026-09-22, 10:00–11:30 (preferred)
- Wed 2026-09-23, 14:00–15:30
- Thu 2026-09-24, 09:00–10:30

Agenda draft attached (Kickoff_Agenda_v1.pdf). High-level asks for the session:
- Introductions & roles (10m)
- Success criteria and milestones (15m)
- Architecture & network access checklist (20m)
- Implementation plan and responsibilities (25m)
- Next steps & action items (10m)

Please confirm: 1) which window works best, 2) list of attendees (names + roles + timezone), and 3) whether you want a 90-minute session with breakout rooms for the architecture deep-dive.

I'll coordinate calendar invites and the Bridge/Miro links once we confirm.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor

Thanks. Wed the 23rd at 14:00 ET works best for our group. We do want the 90-minute slot so the architects can split into the breakout for the network diagram and tokenization flow. Attendees from Integrata (tentative):

Appreciate it —

1) Confirm final attendee roster (names + emails).
2) Share any network allowlist IPs or the preferred process for secure access.
3) Any procurement constraints to flag before SOW review.
